getting_started.title: Up and running in 5 steps
getting_started.intro: Follow this order when first setting up WinProx for your organisation.

admin_portal.title: Administrative portal
admin_portal.intro: Chapters on the signed-in admin portal: teams, locations, issues, tasks, calendar, dashboard and settings.

internet_portal.title: Internet portal
internet_portal.intro: Help for the unit QR and team QR portals on site: sign-in, issues, tasks, photos and team leader features.

step_1_text: Assemble operational teams, add workers and assign a team leader. Link teams to specific categories so tasks always reach the right professionals. Workers sign in easily with their name and a personal icon. You can also add teams and workers in one go via a bulk import (CSV file).
step_2_text: Group units into categories (for example: drills, sanitary, fitness equipment, office or electricity). These categories help filter and organise your assets and are fully tailored to your sector. By linking teams to specific categories, WinProx ensures tasks are always picked up by the right team. Additionally, add locations (such as sites, buildings or floors) and create your units per location: these are the physical machines, spaces or objects for which issues and tasks are registered. Locations and units can also be uploaded via a bulk import (CSV file).
step_3_text: Print the QR codes from the detail page of the location or unit and attach them in a clearly visible place (for example on machines, printers, office furniture or in rooms). Users scan the unit QR to directly open the portal, where they can submit issues and consult documents or announcements. Workers scan the team QR to link or activate dynamic tokens, record the GPS location of the unit and take photos. Additionally, they can start and complete tasks via this route, including adding photos.
step_4_text: Issues come in via a QR scan or manual entry. For each issue, a task is automatically created and directly linked to the responsible team. It is possible to create multiple tasks for one issue (for example for both the technical team and the cleaning crew). Simply set a deadline and track progress closely via the dashboard and the calendar.
step_5_text: Workers carry out tasks on location by scanning the team QR. Once all tasks for an issue have been handled, the administrator can definitively close the issue. All actions remain clearly visible in the audit trail.
